sections.Profile:
The "Elvira and the Party Monsters" pinball machine, released by Bally in October 1989, is a beloved classic designed by Dennis Nordman. This game features the iconic horror hostess Elvira and includes a variety of humorous and spooky elements. The playfield is equipped with two ramps, three flippers, dancing boogie men, and multiple multiball modes. Players enjoy the playful and engaging theme, with callouts by Cassandra Peterson (Elvira) herself.
